title: Prior Goodwill and Corrective Entries and the Rounding of Personal Checking Goodwill Relief
content:
Two cases take the goodwill relief on a Personal Checking account to a finer figure, read from the entries granted to the account in the last twelve months, from the overdraft charges standing on it and from card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

- Where a goodwill or corrective entry has been granted to the account in the last twelve months **and** at least 3 overdraft charges stand, the goodwill relief is taken to the cent.
- Where the case above does not apply **and** either at least 3 such entries have been granted in the last twelve months **or** the owner has made at least 15 card payments in the last twelve months, it is taken in whole dollars, rounded half-up.
- Where neither case applies, the relief is not taken to either of those finer figures.

**Worked rounding on hypothetical inputs.** Take a figure of 10.50 before rounding.

| Owner's position | Goodwill relief |
|---|---|
| 1 goodwill entry in the last twelve months, 4 overdraft charges standing | 10.50 |
| 1 goodwill entry in the last twelve months, 2 overdraft charges standing | 11.00 only where a limb of the second case is met |
| 4 corrective entries in the last twelve months, 2 overdraft charges standing | 11.00 |
| No such entries, 18 card payments in the last twelve months | 11.00 |
| No such entries, 4 card payments | Neither case applies |

The first case counts a single such entry alongside the charges standing; the second counts at least 3 of them, or reaches its card payment limb instead. Equality satisfies each threshold.
